adminPage.title: Admin
adminPage.enabledHint: Results larger than the threshold are written to object storage and returned as a presigned URL instead of inline rows.
adminPage.defaultThresholdHint: Row count above which a result is redirected to object storage rather than returned in the response.
adminPage.defaultFormatHint: File format redirected results are written in.
adminPage.presignedUrlTtlHint: How long the presigned URL for a redirected result stays valid.
adminPage.domainPrefix: Domain prefix (domain_id__ prepended to all names)
adminPage.domainPrefixHint: Prepends the domain to generated names, so two domains can expose a table of the same name.
adminPage.namingConventionHint: Casing applied to GraphQL field names, which Cypher property keys follow as well. Cypher labels are always PascalCase. gRPC, JSON:API and OpenAPI are unaffected — they name each column the way the database spells it.
adminPage.sqlNamingConventionHint: Casing applied to names on the SQL plane — what the pgwire, Bolt and semantic-SQL surfaces query. Set separately from the GraphQL convention so renaming one plane never renames the other.
adminPage.domainModeHint: Single stores every table under one domain; Namespaced requires a domain on every table. Changing this deletes this organization's sources, tables and domains.
adminPage.defaultSampleSizeHint: Row ceiling applied to sampled queries, such as previews and profiling.
adminPage.consumerGroupIdHint: Provisa's Kafka consumer identity for inbound Debezium/Kafka CDC. One group across all sources; a source may override it for offset isolation. Applied on restart.
adminPage.defaultTtlHint: How long a cached response is served before the query is run again.
adminPage.maxObjectDepthHint: How deep introspection follows nested objects when mapping a remote GraphQL schema into tables.
adminPage.maxListDepthHint: Nesting depth at which list fields stop being followed.
adminPage.maxListItemsHint: The first: argument Provisa sends on a remote list field.
adminPage.maxRowsHint: The most rows one read of a paged remote table takes, following its cursor page by page.
adminPage.serverLimitsHint: Different transports carry different workloads; set how long a request on each may run. A request can shorten its own deadline but not exceed this.
adminPage.rowLimitHint: Rows returned when a query sets no LIMIT of its own.
adminPage.rowLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number of rows greater than zero.
adminPage.requestTimeoutDefaultHint: Applies to every transport that has no value of its own.
adminPage.requestTimeoutInvalid: Enter a number of seconds greater than zero.
adminPage.requestTimeoutMissing: The server returned no per-transport request timeouts. The settings payload is incomplete.
